properties.title: Th Abundance · LP GRS 5° (Prettyman et al. 2006)
properties.lri:data_use_note: Th abundance identifies KREEP-rich terrain and is used for global heat balance and radiogenic heating estimates.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Column 14 (W_TH, ppm) of the 5° quasi-equal-area table lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_5deg.tab (Prettyman et al. 2006) is used as ppm directly (no scaling), then the table rows are written as WKT polygons (longitude bin width varies by latitude to preserve equal area; the two polar caps are half the latitude height of the interior bands). The polygons are rasterized onto a fine 0.1°×0.1° grid, then downsampled with mode resampling to a 2.5°×2.5° output grid (half the 5° nominal band height, so the polar caps land exactly on an output pixel edge), then written as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
properties.lri:quality_note_short: Peer-reviewed PDS product, Prettyman et al. (2006). 5° grid (~150 km).
properties.lri:quality_note: Derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra (Prettyman et al. 2006), calibrated against the feldspathic lunar highlands meteorite composition. Validated against independent neutron-derived macroscopic absorption cross sections (Pearson r = 0.9885) and average atomic mass (Pearson r = 0.944). This dataset passed Planetary Data System peer review.
